comparison.objective: Inspect covered cases and return an instrument module to the empty one; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual lid manipulation, camera inspection, carrying, and case insertion versus recessed setscrew manipulation and iterative dynamic adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Module placed in the unoccupied case; entering an occupied case permanently fails. Candidate instead requires safe repeated stopping and lock retention. No separate specs or insertion tolerances are supplied.
comparison.reason: Occupied-case selection and module stowage do not test adjustable damping or setting retention.
